rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a business or corporation.

example.english: That company opened two new branches this year.
example.traditional: 嗰間公司今年開咗兩間新分店。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 hoi1 zo2 loeng5 gaan1 san1 fan1 dim3

rows.note: Use this when companionship is treated as a noun, especially in formal or written language.

example.english: The company of pets is very important to elderly people living alone.
example.traditional: 寵物嘅陪伴對獨居老人好重要。
example.jyutping: cung2 mat6 ge3 pui4 bun6 deoi3 duk6 geoi1 lou5 jan4 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for an organized team of people working together toward a common purpose.

example.english: The team at our company worked together to complete this project.
example.traditional: 公司團隊一齊完成咗呢個項目。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 tyun4 deoi6 jat1 cai4 jyun4 sing4 zo2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6
